utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Ira, what’s the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been hearing good things while I was out running errands, but I don’t have a full update yet. I’ll check in and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira—can you check in today and tell me what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know if I need anything. I’ve got a few things to sort out first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — take your time and just holler when you’re ready. I’m happy to help out with whatever comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can ask around and pass it along when I do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—that’d help. I’m just trying to keep track of where to drop things off and when.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and get you the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring a flashlight and a small toolkit? I’ll handle the rest and meet you by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a flashlight and a small toolkit and meet you by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'm already telling folks about the repair drive. If you want, I can swing by and invite a few more neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Quinn. Thank you for looking out for us.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course—I’ll stop by a few houses this afternoon and spread the word. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to mention.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and moving smoothly. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — let’s start with the tool list and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll draft the tool list and set clear pickup windows. Want me to sort them by priority or by volunteer availability?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the details first so we do this right. What’s the repair drive needing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can swing by late and help with whatever needs fixing. Just tell me what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — can you bring a flashlight, a set of screwdrivers, and maybe some work gloves? I’ll confirm the exact list before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what do we need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that’d be a big help. We need a few volunteers, some basic tools, and a way to sort the repair list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the priority list and line up volunteers around pickup and drop-off times. If you send me the tool list, I’ll start matching it up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and a few folks already signed up to help this afternoon. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yes please—just the quick version would be great. Who’s helping and what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m in—just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you confirm you’ll actually look through it today?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ll look through it today—send it over and I’ll skim the key points.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest, but I can check in and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey. I’d really appreciate that—I keep losing track of what’s left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll ask around and jot down what’s still pending, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to everyone I see and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and check in with folks about the drive. Just tell me if the supply list changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m sorry, I just need a second to remember what we were planning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we were going to check the repair drive details and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, yes — let me think. I can help check what’s left to fix, and we can go through the details together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can, bring a screwdriver set and some spare batteries. That should cover the basic fixes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll grab a screwdriver set and some spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Gus. Let’s keep it simple—what tools should I bring, and when should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring a screwdriver, a hammer, and some pliers if you’ve got them. Swing by Saturday morning and we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara — we still need a few extra hands for sorting supplies and handing out flyers. If you’re free, I can put you on the list and pass the word along too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please put me on the list, and I can take flyers around the block this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the latest on what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — right now we still need a few drop-off spots confirmed, plus a list of the bigger repair items people are bringing in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can help confirm a couple drop-off spots and start a running list of the bigger items. Send me whatever you have, and I’ll keep people in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Cleo, if you have any priorities, send them my way and I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — my top priority is extra tape, batteries, and a couple of clean tarps if you can fit them in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll make sure tape, batteries, and clean tarps are on the list and I’ll keep you updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m a little behind on the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you bring any tools you’re willing to lend and let me know if you can help sort donations? I’m trying to keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I can bring a few tools to lend, and I should be able to help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’ll swing by the repair drive and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. If you can let me know what they need, I’ll work it around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem — I’ll check in and text you what they need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still okay helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still in and happy to help with the repair drive.
